Brunn–Minkowski concavity, strict nonhomothety of unequal lenses and endpoint derivative bounds establish the unique interior crossing and correct order. Strict inclusion C_r inside sqrt(1-r^2)B gives the improved obstruction. Uniform compact-interior endpoint integration and Stirling yield the n^-7/30 factor and exact constant. Independently recomputed numerical crossings for n=2,3,5,10,30 and symbolically confirmed the published formula constant is algebraically identical. Finite numerics do not prove the all-n asymptotics.
